map.Western Ontario and McMaster Universitie: Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index; assesses knee/hip osteoarthritis symptom severity over the past 48 hours
map.规律NSAIDs+物理治疗+减重: Regular NSAIDs + physical therapy + weight loss
map.提示：WOMAC是骨关节炎疗效评估的金标准。标准化总分=(原始分/96)×100: Note: WOMAC is the gold standard for osteoarthritis outcome assessment. Normalized total = (raw score/96)×100. WOMAC can assess pain and function dimensions separately. Treatment response: MCID (minimal clinically important difference) is about 6-12 points drop in normalized total. K-L radiographic grade correlates weakly with WOMAC; combine with clinical judgment. For clinical reference only.
map.疼痛 5 项各 2 = 10、僵硬 2 项各 2 = 4、功能 17 项各 2: Pain 5 items ×2 = 10, stiffness 2 items ×2 = 4, function 17 items ×2 = 34 → total 48/96; pain/stiffness/function normalized 50%/50%/50%, moderate-severe.
map.各题多 1 → 12/96，轻度，建议运动疗法与减重。: Each item mostly 1 → 12/96, mild, suggest exercise therapy and weight loss.
map.疼痛 0–20、僵硬 0–8、功能 0–68，总分 0–96；标化 = 各项/满: Pain 0-20, stiffness 0-8, function 0-68, total 0-96; normalized = each/full ×100% for comparison.
map.后者为中文版同算法实现，本页为英文版，评分规则一致。: The latter is the Chinese-version implementation of the same algorithm; this page is the English version, identical scoring rules.
map.骨关节炎WOMAC指数计算器，通过24项Likert量表(疼痛5项、僵硬2项、功: Osteoarthritis WOMAC index calculator assesses knee/hip OA severity via 24-item Likert scale (5 pain, 2 stiffness, 17 function). A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
